ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
The diffpy.Structure package provides objects for storing atomic
coordinates, displacement parameters and other crystal structure data.
diffpy.Structure supports import and export of structure data in several
structure formats such as CIF, PDB, xyz. It provides conversion between
fractional and absolute Cartesian coordinates, functions for symmetry
expansion from asymmetric unit and generation of symmetry constraints for
atom positions and displacement parameters. diffpy.Structure includes
definitions of all space groups in over 500 symmetry settings.
about.summary: Crystal structure container and parsers for structure formats.

name: diffpy.structure
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "diffpy.structure" %}
{% set version = "3.5.1" %}
{% set python_min = "3.12" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/d/diffpy_structure/diffpy_structure-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 461de983fa40a0ccd8a904bd7028cc6d619b90bcca48a78a4b48731fbffa97cd

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - setuptools >=62
    - setuptools-git-versioning >=2.0
    - pip

  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - numpy
    - pycifrw
    - diffpy.utils

test:
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - pytest
  source_files:
    - tests
  commands:
    - pip check
    - pip list
    - pytest

about:
  home: https://github.com/diffpy/diffpy.structure/
  license: LicenseRef-diffpy
  license_file: LICENSE.rst
  summary: Crystal structure container and parsers for structure formats.
  description: |
    The diffpy.Structure package provides objects for storing atomic
    coordinates, displacement parameters and other crystal structure data.
    diffpy.Structure supports import and export of structure data in several
    structure formats such as CIF, PDB, xyz. It provides conversion between
    fractional and absolute Cartesian coordinates, functions for symmetry
    expansion from asymmetric unit and generation of symmetry constraints for
    atom positions and displacement parameters. diffpy.Structure includes
    definitions of all space groups in over 500 symmetry settings.
  doc_url: http://www.diffpy.org/diffpy.structure/
  dev_url: https://github.com/diffpy/diffpy.structure

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - bobleesj
    - dragonyanglong
    - pavoljuhas
    - st3107
    - sbillinge
